plan_corrections.plan_claim: The reset is an exact sampled reference state because the configured reference-noise multiplier is zero.
plan_corrections.source_fact: Joint and ordinary root noise amplitudes are zero, but 30% of resets set root z to 0.5 m and rotate the root by a shared-sign plus or minus 90 degrees about x.

plan_corrections.plan_claim: The native parity profile is adequately described without observation noise.
plan_corrections.source_fact: Observation-noise curriculum is disabled, so its multiplier is 1 rather than 0; actor joint position, joint velocity, gravity, and angular velocity are noisy. Privileged state is noise-free.

plan_corrections.plan_claim: The native parity profile is adequately described without domain randomization.
plan_corrections.source_fact: Startup body-mass, material-friction, and torso-COM randomization, episodic default-joint-offset randomization, and timed velocity pushes are enabled.

plan_corrections.plan_claim: The 10 second timeout occurs after 500 actions.
plan_corrections.source_fact: The source tests episode_length > ceil(10 / 0.02), so the done transition is the 501st applied action at 10.02 seconds.

plan_corrections.plan_claim: A raw action becomes a 0.25-radian PD target offset.
plan_corrections.source_fact: The raw action is multiplied by 5 and clipped, then multiplied by 0.25 and joint effort_limit/stiffness before adding the randomized default pose.

plan_corrections.plan_claim: The G1 route is simply a 31-body codec.
plan_corrections.source_fact: The simulated asset and robot list have 30 bodies; a synthetic head rigid frame attached 0.35 m above the torso makes the materialized kinematic route 31 bodies.

plan_corrections.plan_claim: The privileged width discrepancy is only a documentation typo.
plan_corrections.source_fact: The YAML declares 462 and therefore the underlying actor space declares 927, while runtime tensors are 463 and 928. The released wrapper reconstructs runtime spaces and consumes 463.

plan_corrections.plan_claim: BFM history is four time-major 93-wide frames and excludes reset seeds.
plan_corrections.source_fact: History is field-major, with four newest-first values per field. Initial explicit reset is excluded, but an internal same-step autoreset seed is inserted after observation computation and appears one action later. Phase 2 intentionally excludes every seed node.

plan_corrections.plan_claim: Last action and transition action can share one field.
plan_corrections.source_fact: Replay stores the raw behavior action in [-1,1], while last_action, action-rate evidence, and history use the processed action after multiply-by-5 and clipping.

plan_corrections.plan_claim: The reference cursor advances at the current episode step.
plan_corrections.source_fact: Reset state is sampled at start_time, while tracking/reference facts are queried at start_time + (episode_length + 1) * 0.02 seconds.

plan_corrections.plan_claim: Eight physical facts describe the complete native environment reward.
plan_corrections.source_fact: The learner auxiliary route has eight raw facts; the environment scalar has ten active terms, adding feet_heading_alignment and limits_dof_vel.

plan_corrections.plan_claim: Source reward coefficients can be copied directly into an IsaacLab reward manager.
plan_corrections.source_fact: Environment YAML coefficients are reward densities multiplied by control dt and then by an eight-channel penalty curriculum. Learner auxiliary coefficients instead weight raw per-transition facts without dt.

action.estimated_torque_evidence: clip(kp_scale * kp * (target_joint_position - joint_position) - kd_scale * kd * joint_velocity, +/- torque_limit)
